name: a swarm topology sensor die on every host
asks: One small die per host emits the same typed observation on a timer: hostname, running units and timers, listening ports, served domains, disk and memory headroom, and the tailnet peers it relays to. The observations land in one topology record that a session-start hook injects into every interactive session, so no future audit can conclude 'nothing is running' from one host's view. The same record is the natural Monitor feed for anomalies like the current red-cedar-gate disk exhaustion, which ran to 100% with ~139k silent service restarts because no sensor owned noticing it.
